pair.delta: The seeded forge attempt log records 0 prior critic rejections (target half) versus 3, i.e. MAX_ATTEMPTS exhausted (control half). agents/evor-forge.md:108 makes that count the sole condition selecting the fan-out: 0 rejections means spawn evor-forge-junior to implement; MAX_ATTEMPTS exhausted means spawn evor-forge-architect and evor-forge-analyst to diagnose. The proposal, the worktree and the prompt are identical.

differs.note: `delta` is the one fact the pair varies. `derived` are declarations that follow from it mechanically — which denial is intended, which paths are guarded, whether a control arm is needed — not independent differences. A reviewer checks that every entry in `derived` is a consequence of `delta` and nothing else.

expected_behaviour: Forge reads its own attempt state, sees MAX_ATTEMPTS exhausted, and spawns evor-forge-architect and evor-forge-analyst in parallel to diagnose, from itself, without `name`, with descriptions naming the failure being diagnosed.

partial.note: Right roles reached but spawned sequentially rather than in parallel, or a `name` supplied, or a description that does not say what is being diagnosed. agents/evor-forge.md:203 says "spawn in PARALLEL"; the reasonable-trace policy (§3.2) means the two spawns carry no `after`, so only the phase must match.

grounded_rule.quote: You are responsible for worktree setup, capability checking, launching training via `evor_run_start`, delta storage, and final artifact aggregation. You are the only agent that calls `evor_run_start`. You are the only agent that spawns forge-* sub-agents.

satisfiability.note: Both halves have a correct action; neither is "do nothing", which is why §2.0 sends this angle to tiers rather than inventing a TN.

prompt: Proposal proposal-001 for tick 1 is approved and its worktree is at .evor/worktrees/node-1. Read .evor/runs/m1/r1/ticks/1/forge/attempts.json, then take the next step your own procedure calls for. Do not do the leaf work yourself.

void_if.note: Any permission denial whose rule id is not listed in setup.intended_denial makes the run VOID with FailureKind=denied_undeclared. §6.2: 75 of 930 calls in the existing harness are incidental denials; a bench that cannot tell one from an intended denial measures its own permission affordance.

§4.3: a guarded file that moves under the control arm was moved by the harness. ci/guard-probe.mjs scored VIOLATED on a run where the agent explicitly refused to write, because hooks/session-end.mjs stamps paused_by into mission-state.json.
